prompt: What is the genre of the text?
promptSpeech: What is the genre of the text? Fantasy, Realistic fiction, or Informational text?

data.passage:
Butterflies are beautiful insects that come in many colors and patterns. They start their life as tiny eggs on leaves. Then, they hatch into caterpillars that eat a lot of leaves to grow. Next, the caterpillar forms a hard shell called a chrysalis. Inside the chrysalis, it changes into a butterfly. When it comes out, it spreads its new wings and flies away.

Butterflies love to drink nectar from flowers using their long tongues. They help plants grow by carrying pollen from one flower to another. Butterflies like warm, sunny places and cannot fly when it is cold. Some butterflies travel long distances to find food and warmth. They rest at night and become active when the sun comes up. Butterflies make our world more colorful and beautiful!

hint: Facts and real information mean informational text.
explanation: The text teaches true, real facts about butterflies and how they grow, so it is an informational text.
